name: Bachelor of Architecture
description: The Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) at AIKTC School of Architecture is a distinguished 5-year professional program approved by the Council of Architecture (COA Code: MH-57), DTE Maharashtra, and affiliated with the University of Mumbai. The program synthesizes art, environmental sustainability, structural technology, and socio-cultural context to cultivate visionary architects. The pedagogy centers on hands-on design studios spanning Architectural Design, Urban Planning, Sustainable Environmental Design, Landscape Architecture, History of Architecture, and Building Construction. Students learn traditional manual graphic drafting and advanced parametric digital design (AutoCAD, Revit BIM, Rhino, SketchUp, Photoshop).
highlights: Approved intake of 40 seats recognized by the Council of Architecture (COA) and affiliated with the University of Mumbai.

Comprehensive creative infrastructure including spacious naturally-lit Design Studios, Building Construction Lab, Climatology Lab (solar scopes, lux meters), 3D Model-Making Workshop, and Carpentry/Material Museum.
Active participation in national NASA (National Association of Students of Architecture) conventions, exhibitions, and regional design competitions.
Mandatory practical architectural training/internship with prominent architectural studios, urban planning firms, and design agencies across India.
career_opportunities: Principal Architect, Urban Designer, Interior Architect, Landscape Architect, Sustainable Design Consultant, Heritage Conservation Specialist, and BIM Manager.
eligibility: H.S.C. in PCM / Diploma with Mathematics & Qualifying score in NATA / JEE (Paper 2).
vision: To be the most sought after academic, research and practice based school of Architecture that others would wish to emulate.

labs.name: Design Studio
labs.description: Spacious drafting rooms equipped with professional drawing boards, parallel rulers, and ergonomically designed seating.

labs.name: Building Construction Lab
labs.description: Displays various construction details, materials assembly models, structural joints, and miniature scale structures.

labs.name: Climatology Lab
labs.description: Equipped with solar scope, lux meters, wind anemometers, and thermometers for environmental and climate-responsive design analysis.

labs.name: Computer Aided Design (CAD) Lab
labs.description: Workstations running CAD, Revit, SketchUp, Photoshop, and 3D modeling programs for digital representation.

labs.name: Model Making Workshop
labs.description: Equipped with laser cutters, hot wire foam cutters, and wood/plastic working tools for 3D physical models creation.

labs.name: Material Museum
labs.description: A comprehensive repository of construction materials, cladding specimens, paint finishes, hardware, and structural elements.

alumni_testimonial.name: Khot Sharabil Simab
alumni_testimonial.quote: My five years at AIKTC laid the strongest foundation for who I am today as an architect. The mentors pushed my limits, and countless late nights turned sketches into reality.
